title: Plural genitive: common consonant-stem alternatives
summary: Learn the common -ten forms and the vowel-stem alternatives shown here: kieli (“language”) → kielten.
objectives: Learn the common -ten forms and the vowel-stem alternatives shown here: kieli (“language”) → kielten.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A plural genitive refers to more than one person or thing. Its ending belongs to the plural modifier, not necessarily to the thing owned. Here the task is forming the word.
Learn the common -ten forms and the vowel-stem alternatives shown here. The stem changes are word-specific; do not add -ten to every dictionary form.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Use kiel- + ten = kielten, or kieli- + en = kielien.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Use pien- + ten = pienten, or pieni- + en = pienien.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Use suur- + ten = suurten, or suuri- + en = suurien.

Use nuor- + ten = nuorten, or nuori- + en = nuorien.

Use the consonant stem las- in lasten, or lapsi- + en = lapsien.

Use mies- + ten = miesten, or miehi- + en = miehien.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Use saar- + ten = saarten, or saari- + en = saarien.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.

Keep the requested number: singular is one, plural is more than one.
A slash between model forms marks accepted alternatives; write just one form.

practiceExercises.prompt: Complete the plural genitive of kieli (“language”): kielte____. Write only the missing letter.
practiceExercises.explanation: Use kiel- + ten = kielten, or kieli- + en = kielien. These standard forms are all accepted: kielten, kielien.

practiceExercises.prompt: Complete the plural genitive of pieni (“small”): ____n. Write only the letters before the final n.
practiceExercises.explanation: Use pien- + ten = pienten, or pieni- + en = pienien. These standard forms are all accepted: pienten, pienien.

practiceExercises.prompt: Practise the plural genitives in order, separated by a comma: vuori (“mountain”); saari (“island”).
practiceExercises.explanation: Use vuor- + ten = vuorten, or vuori- + en = vuorien. These standard forms are all accepted: vuorten, vuorien. Use saar- + ten = saarten, or saari- + en = saarien. These standard forms are all accepted: saarten, saarien.
